body:
## Problem

Local UI review screenshots can land as untracked root-level PNG files in the main checkout. The new `Update App` safety check correctly treats any dirty worktree, including untracked files, as blocked.

Observed examples that blocked the update button after #38 merged:

```text
issue-34-review-fixes-update-button.png
issue-34-update-panel-mobile.png
issue-34-update-panel.png
issue-34-update-summary-row-loaded.png
issue-34-update-summary-row.png
pr22-d429-tooltip-clipping.png
pr22-live-dashboard-check.png
pr22-live-desktop.png
pr22-simulated-desktop.png
pr22-simulated-mobile.png
```

These were moved to `/tmp/opencode/` to unblock the test, but we should prevent recurrence.

## Suggested Scope

- Decide the canonical location for ad hoc local screenshots, e.g. `/tmp/opencode/`, `dashboard-snapshots/`, or another gitignored scratch directory.
- Update docs or scripts so UI smoke screenshots do not default to the repo root.
- Consider expanding `.gitignore` for known local screenshot naming patterns without hiding tracked docs screenshots.
- Keep `docs/screenshots/*.png` explicitly trackable for README assets.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Ad hoc UI review screenshots no longer dirty the main checkout.
- `docs/screenshots/*.png` remain trackable.
- `Update App` is not blocked by common local screenshot artifacts.
- The recommended screenshot output location is documented or enforced by tooling.
title: Keep local UI review screenshots from blocking app updates
